title: Oven-Roasted Chili Pepper Broccoli
summary: Crisp-edged broccoli with garlic, chili flakes and a squeeze of lemon. Goes with almost any protein.

ingredients.prep: cut into florets, stems peeled and sliced

ingredients.note: gochugaru is milder and works well next to Korean food

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F with a sheet pan inside. A hot pan is what gives you browned edges instead of steamed broccoli.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: In a big bowl, toss the broccoli with the olive oil, salt, pepper and chili flakes until every floret is glossy.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Spread on the hot pan in one layer, cut sides down. Roast 15 minutes without touching it.

steps.title: Add garlic
steps.text: Scatter the garlic over the top, toss once, and roast until the edges are deeply browned and the garlic is golden, 5 to 8 minutes more.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Squeeze the lemon over everything and toss with the parmesan if using. Taste for salt.

notes: Garlic goes in late so it doesn't burn. If the oven is already at a different temperature for a main, anything from 400 to 450°F works; adjust time by eye.
